definition: Pushing a sidelane while split from the team. A [splitpusher](/term/splitpusher) [pressures](/term/pressure) the opposing team to send one or more [players](/term/player) to respond, giving the splitpusher’s allies time to make a [play](/term/play) on the opposite side of the map. Splitpushing as a strategy is often contrasted with [teamfighting](/term/teamfight).
